Biniam is talking to the careers adviser at school.
sentences.Han vil finne en deltidsjobb, og han tre: He wants to find a part-time job, and he needs some good advice.
sentences.Har du søkt på noen jobber?: Have you applied for any jobs?
sentences.Nei. Jeg synes det er vanskelig, for jeg: No. I find it difficult, because I have no work experience. I haven't worked in Norway, and hardly in Eritrea either.
sentences.Nei, men det er fordi du er så ung. Du h: No, but that's because you're so young. Surely you have a little experience of working?
Yes, I helped my grandmother a lot.
sentences.Hun satt i rullestol, og da bestefar død: She was in a wheelchair, and when Grandad died, she needed a lot of help.
sentences.Jeg stelte henne, hjalp henne med å lage: I looked after her, helped her cook and tidied and cleaned her house.
sentences.Så flott! Du har jo arbeidserfaring. Det: How great! So you do have work experience. You must put that in your CV. You mustn't give up. I'm sure you can do a lot more.
sentences.Læreren min på barneskolen sa alltid at: My teacher at primary school always said that I was good at helping others in the class, and that I was patient and calm.
sentences.Så bra. Det er viktige egenskaper i mang: Very good. Those are important qualities in many jobs. If you write that in a job application, it makes a good impression. What do your friends say about you?
sentences.De sier at jeg smiler og ler mye, og de: They say that I smile and laugh a lot, and they say that I'm always in a good mood, and that I always manage things on my own without help. How can I write that in an application?
You can write that you are cheerful and positive. If you like doing tasks on your own, you are an independent person. You can write that too.
sentences.Vennene mine sier også at jeg er litt tr: My friends also say that I'm a bit slow and take a long time over things.
sentences.Det bør du ikke skrive i søknaden, for d: You shouldn't write that in the application, because it makes a bad impression, but you can write that you are thorough. The most important thing is to be honest.
sentences.Takk for tipset! Nå skal jeg gå hjem og: Thanks for the tip! Now I'm going to go home and write a CV and apply for jobs.
sentences.Lykke til! Ta kontakt hvis du trenger me: Good luck! Get in touch if you need more help.
sentences.Biniam er hos rådgiveren på skolen og få: Biniam is at the careers adviser's at school and gets tips on writing a CV and a job application.
sentences.Biniam har aldri jobbet i hjemlandet sit: Biniam has never worked in his home country or in Norway, but he has experience of looking after his grandmother.
sentences.Han har også mange gode egenskaper som e: He also has lots of good qualities that are good to write about in a job application.
sentences.Når han kommer hjem, skal han skrive cv: When he gets home, he is going to write a CV and apply for some jobs.
sentences.Hvis han trenger mer hjelp, kan han ta k: If he needs more help, he can get in touch with the careers adviser.
